ledger.x: 1504: Ferdinand of Aragon holds all Naples.
7 July 1647: Masaniello's revolt begins in Naples.
1734: the Habsburg viceroyalty ends with the Spanish conquest; the Bourbon kingdom of Naples follows.

wars.name: Franco-Spanish war over Naples
wars.outcome: Aragon and France resumed their war over the partitioned kingdom in 1502; Gonzalo Fernandez de Cordoba expelled the French and Ferdinand held the whole kingdom by 1504.

wars.name: Neapolitan Revolt
wars.outcome: The people of Naples formed the Neapolitan Republic with French assistance; Spanish troops suppressed it in 1647-1648.

wars.name: War of the Polish Succession
wars.outcome: A Spanish army conquered Naples and Sicily in 1734 and Charles of Bourbon was installed as king from 1735.

certainty.note: No page opened gives frontier lines; the Cliopatria shape of 1501 is reused.
